title: CRYO BARREL ICE SLIDE
why: His order (2026-10-19): "Player should slide across cold patches made by ice barrels, with limited direction change, like players feet are ice, ala Fortnite. Ice should not hurt player". The frost fog hurt the player 2 every half second and the cryo blast up to 20; both now do the player nothing (the bodies keep every effect), and the fog leaves an ice sheet: on it the walk keeps momentum, steers slowly and glides, the leftover momentum is gone in under 0.3 s off it, and walls still stop him. The fog radius (96) and life (5 s) are unchanged. The sheet is its own item in the draw order under the bodies, because the fog cloud is sorted over them.
now: A cryo barrel now leaves a slick ice sheet under its frost fog: a pillager on it runs up to 1.2 times faster, steers slowly (a turn about takes a second), glides on with no input and is still stopped by walls, and neither the fog nor the cryo blast hurts him.
